title: The Signals We Leave Behind
subtitle: Immovable Giants · Album
excerpt: A patient, expansive record about memory, distance, endurance and the traces people leave behind.
body: The Signals We Leave Behind is Immovable Giants at their most expansive. Built from slow-burning guitars, enormous dynamics and deeply human songwriting, the album explores what remains after the moment has passed—the people we lose, the places we outgrow and the pieces of ourselves we leave behind along the way. Rather than chasing immediacy, Immovable Giants let each song breathe until its emotional weight becomes impossible to ignore. It is a record about endurance, memory and the quiet evidence that we were here.
